start.text: You've got the wrong warehouse, friend. I'd turn around if I were you.

choices.text: Harrington. You were at the manor Thursday night.
Lady Harrington sent me. She wants a word.

manor_deny.text: Don't know what you're talking about.

choices.text: I found your contract. Ten pounds for a night's work.

lady_h_bluff.text: She doesn't send people. She writes. And you don't look like a footman.

choices.text: Sharp. I'm a detective. It's over.

contract_confront.text: You had better leave this warehouse right now. Before this gets considerably worse for you.

choices.text: She's going to prison. You can go with her or testify against her.

doyle_rattled.text: She promised I would never be touched. That was the arrangement.

choices.text: That arrangement is finished. Talk to me now or face the Inspector alone.

doyle_breaks.text: I was paid to go in, make it look like the old man had a fall, and leave. She arranged everything else. I want no more part of it.

choices.text: You'll need to say that in front of the Inspector.
